title: 3x Obesity Risk Comes From Unequal Activity, Not Average Steps
hook: Unequal activity nearly triples obesity risk, even beyond average steps.
closing: Public health improves when more people can move, not just when averages rise.
question: Who gets fewer walking opportunities?

segments.say: Hong Kong averages 6,880 daily steps, but a national average cannot show who gets left behind.
High-inequality countries reach 297 on the obesity index, nearly tripling the low-inequality baseline.
The gender step gap explains 43 percent of activity inequality, revealing who loses movement opportunities.
